name: ai-tool-performance-architecture
title: Research AI tool performance architecture
description: Study t3code architecture and performance tactics, compare them with opencode, and turn the findings into an implementation plan focused on event ingestion, frontend rendering, and state synchronization.
creator: claude-agent
notes: Main hypothesis: opencode already has strong client-side batching and rendering protections, but more event coalescing and finalize logic should move closer to provider/server ingestion so app and TUI consume a more stable read model. Immediate focus is observation, reducer-side delta batching, TUI coalescing parity, and revisiting working-session virtualization strategy.
